items.quote: Miller Time recently cleaned and sealed the paver driveway and lanai at our home in Naples, and we couldn't be happier with the results. The driveway has terrific curb appeal now, and the lanai pavers look fresh and uniform.

I can't say enough great things about MillerTime Pressure Washing! From start to finish, the team was friendly, professional, and an absolute pleasure to work with. The pricing was more than reasonable for the quality of work they did.

Their pricing was competitive, and they did an excellent job overall. The work was completed promptly, and everything looked great when they finished. The lanai, in particular, looked brand new again. I would definitely recommend their services and wouldn't hesitate to use them again in the future.
